"""Native detail-menu and editor-exit evidence in the existing synthetic fixture.

The ordinary automation and business case schemas remain unchanged. This
additional observation must pass independently and never submits a server write.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import contextmanager
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re

from automation_ui_probe import navigation_menu_absent, navigation_target, navigation_window

PACKAGE = "ru.omnicio.app.debug"
DETAILS = {
    "strategy": ("strategies", "Стратегия"),
    "markets": ("market", "Рынок"),
    "notifications": ("messages", "События"),
    "assistant": ("assistant", "Ассистент"),
    "appearance": ("appearance", "Оформление"),
    "library": ("library", "Исследования"),
}


def detail_marker(tree):
    if navigation_window(tree) is None:
        return None
    records = []
    for node in tree.iter("node"):
        if node.get("resource-id") not in {"navigation-detail-page", PACKAGE + ":id/navigation-detail-page"}:
            continue
        if node.get("package") != PACKAGE or node.get("visible-to-user") != "true" or node.get("enabled") != "true":
            continue
        fields = [part.split(":", 1) for part in node.get("content-desc", "").split(";") if ":" in part]
        value = dict(fields)
        expected = {"navigation-detail", "transport", "page", "requests", "writes", "contract-errors", "prefs", "user"}
        if len(fields) != len(value) or set(value) != expected \
                or value["navigation-detail"] != "business-strategy/ready" or value["transport"] != "synthetic":
            raise AssertionError("Detail navigation fixture identity is invalid")
        if value["page"] not in DETAILS or any(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{1,12}", value[key]) is None
                                              for key in ("requests", "writes", "contract-errors")):
            raise AssertionError("Detail navigation page/counters are invalid")
        counts = {key: int(value[key]) for key in ("requests", "writes", "contract-errors")}
        if counts["contract-errors"] or counts["writes"] or counts["writes"] > counts["requests"]:
            raise AssertionError("Navigation submitted a mutation or invalid fixture request")
        prefs = value["prefs"].split(",")
        if len(prefs) != 8 or prefs[0] not in {"AURORA", "OCEAN", "IRIS"} \
                or prefs[1] not in {"COMFORT", "COMPACT"} or prefs[2] not in {"LIVE", "SUBDUED", "OFF"} \
                or any(flag not in {"true", "false"} for flag in prefs[3:]) \
                or re.fullmatch(r"synthetic-business-[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}", value["user"]) is None:
            raise AssertionError("Detail fixture preferences or isolated user identity are invalid")
        if counts["requests"]:
            records.append({"page": value["page"], "requests": counts["requests"], "writes": 0,
                            "contract_errors": 0, "preferences": value["prefs"], "user": value["user"]})
    if len(records) > 1:
        raise AssertionError("Ambiguous native detail navigation fixture")
    return records[0] if records else None


def visible_label(tree, label):
    from profile_ui_probe import node_bounds
    window = navigation_window(tree)
    if window is None:
        return None
    matches = []
    for node in tree.iter("node"):
        if node.get("package") != PACKAGE or node.get("visible-to-user") != "true" \
                or node.get("enabled") != "true":
            continue
        values = [part.strip() for key in ("text", "content-desc") for part in node.get(key, "").splitlines()]
        if label not in values:
            continue
        try:
            left, top, right, bottom = node_bounds(node)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AssertionError):
            continue
        if 0 <= left < right <= window[0] and 0 <= top < bottom <= window[1]:
            matches.append(node)
    if len(matches) > 1:
        raise AssertionError("Ambiguous native dialog title")
    return matches[0] if matches else None


def wide_rail_frame(tree, scale):
    """Require the real portrait breakpoint, production rail and no phone bar."""
    from profile_ui_probe import node_bounds
    from spatial_frame_evidence import ready_native_screen_metrics
    renderer = ready_native_screen_metrics(tree, "business-strategy", scale)
    window = navigation_window(tree)
    if renderer is None or window is None:
        return None
    density = renderer["density"]
    if window[0] / density < 840 or not 0 < window[0] < window[1]:
        raise AssertionError("The wide panel case did not reach the real portrait breakpoint")
    forbidden = {value for resource in ("navigation-menu-open", "analyst-bottom-bar")
                 for value in (resource, PACKAGE + ":id/" + resource)}
    if not navigation_menu_absent(tree) or any(node.get("resource-id") in forbidden
            and node.get("visible-to-user") != "false" for node in tree.iter("node")):
        raise AssertionError("Wide navigation retained a phone menu or bottom bar")
    minimum = math.ceil(48 * density - 1e-6)
    rail = navigation_target(tree, "analyst-side-rail", minimum=minimum, touch=False)
    if rail is None:
        return None
    bounds = node_bounds(rail)
    targets = []
    for destination, label in (("home", "Главная"), ("actions", "Решения"), ("profile", "Настройки")):
        resource = "rail-destination-" + destination
        target = navigation_target(tree, resource, minimum=minimum, touch=False, label=label,
                                   selected=destination == "profile")
        if target is None:
            return None
        target_bounds = node_bounds(target)
        if not (bounds[0] <= target_bounds[0] < target_bounds[2] <= bounds[2]
                and bounds[1] <= target_bounds[1] < target_bounds[3] <= bounds[3]):
            raise AssertionError("A primary navigation target is outside the actual side rail")
        targets.append({"resource": resource, "bounds": list(target_bounds),
                        "selected": target.get("selected") == "true"})
    return {"width": window[0], "height": window[1], "width_dp": window[0] / density,
            "density": density, "window_id": window[2], "rail_bounds": list(bounds), "targets": targets}


def _wm_state(command):
    result = {}
    for setting, pattern in (("size", r"([1-9][0-9]{1,3})x([1-9][0-9]{1,3})"),
                             ("density", r"([1-9][0-9]{1,3})")):
        text = command("shell", "wm", setting)
        rows = {}
        for line in text.splitlines():
            match = re.fullmatch(r"(Physical|Override) " + setting + r": " + pattern, line.strip())
            if match is None or match.group(1) in rows:
                raise AssertionError("Cannot establish exact original emulator display " + setting)
            rows[match.group(1)] = line.strip().split(": ", 1)[1]
        if set(rows) not in ({"Physical"}, {"Physical", "Override"}):
            raise AssertionError("Missing original emulator display " + setting)
        for value in rows.values():
            dimensions = tuple(map(int, value.split("x")))
            if setting == "size" and (not 240 <= dimensions[0] < dimensions[1] <= 4096) \
                    or setting == "density" and not 72 <= dimensions[0] <= 1000:
                raise AssertionError("Original display is outside the bounded portrait emulator contract")
        result[setting] = rows
    return result


def _owned_emulator(probe):
    from persistent_ui import FrameReader, assert_disposable
    reader = getattr(probe.read_tree, "__self__", None)
    if not isinstance(reader, FrameReader) or reader.broken:
        raise AssertionError("Wide display changes require the owned persistent frame session")
    # The ordinary caller runs inside test_apk_installation's unchanged canonical
    # exclusive_emulator lease. This identity must also belong to that process,
    # rather than another AVD or a physical device exposed by the same ADB server.
    assert_disposable(probe.device)
    output = probe.command("emu", "avd", "name")
    if len(output) > 4096:
        raise AssertionError("The wide AVD identity response exceeds its protocol limit")
    # Match the existing boot-readiness parser: blank lines and OK are console
    # framing, never identities. Still require exactly one payload belonging
    # to this process; a second name, error or foreign process remains fatal.
    raw_lines = output.splitlines()
    lines = [line.strip() for line in raw_lines if line.strip()]
    identities = [line for line in lines if line != "OK"]
    allowed = {"analyst-install-" + str(os.getpid()) + "-" + str(attempt) for attempt in (1, 2)}
    owned = len(identities) == 1 and identities[0] in allowed
    print("NAVIGATION_AVD_IDENTITY=" + json.dumps({
        "line_count": len(lines), "blank_lines": len(raw_lines) - len(lines),
        "acknowledgements": lines.count("OK"), "payload_count": len(identities),
        "matches_current_process": owned,
    }, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    if not owned:
        raise AssertionError("The wide case refuses a different process's emulator")
    return {"avd": identities[0], "owner_process_id": os.getpid(), "physical_device": False}


@contextmanager
def wide_emulator_viewport(probe, receipt):
    """Temporarily use 960x1600/160dpi only on this run's disposable emulator."""
    receipt["owner"] = _owned_emulator(probe)
    before = _wm_state(probe.command)
    scale = probe.command("shell", "settings", "get", "system", "font_scale").strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9](?:\.[0-9]{1,3})?", scale) is None or not 0.5 <= float(scale) <= 3:
        raise AssertionError("The wide case cannot restore the actual original font scale")
    receipt.update(before=before, original_font_scale=scale, restored=False)
    failure = None
    touched = False
    try:
        # Set touched first: a transport error may follow an already applied change.
        touched = True
        probe.command("shell", "wm", "size", "960x1600")
        probe.command("shell", "wm", "density", "160")
        actual = _wm_state(probe.command)
        if actual["size"].get("Override", actual["size"]["Physical"]) != "960x1600" \
                or actual["density"].get("Override", actual["density"]["Physical"]) != "160" \
                or any(actual[key]["Physical"] != before[key]["Physical"] for key in before):
            raise AssertionError("The dedicated wide emulator display did not apply exactly")
        receipt["during"] = actual
        yield
    except BaseException as error:
        failure = error
        raise
    finally:
        errors = []
        if touched:
            for setting in ("density", "size"):
                try:
                    probe.command("shell", "wm", setting, before[setting].get("Override", "reset"))
                except Exception as error:
                    errors.append(type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
            try:
                probe.command("shell", "settings", "put", "system", "font_scale", scale)
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append(type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
            try:
                after = _wm_state(probe.command)
                actual_scale = probe.command("shell", "settings", "get", "system", "font_scale").strip()
                receipt["after"] = after
                receipt["font_scale_after"] = actual_scale
                if after != before or actual_scale != scale:
                    raise AssertionError("The exact original display overrides/font scale were not restored")
                width, height = map(int, before["size"].get("Override", before["size"]["Physical"]).split("x"))
                def restored_frame():
                    tree = probe.tree()
                    return tree is not None and tree.get("display-width") == str(width) \
                        and tree.get("display-height") == str(height)
                probe.wait_for(restored_frame, "The original phone viewport did not return")
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append(type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error))
        receipt["restored"] = not errors and touched
        if errors:
            receipt["restore_errors"] = errors
            message = "Failed to restore the owned emulator display: " + "; ".join(errors)
            if failure is None:
                raise AssertionError(message)
            failure.add_note(message)


class _DetailNavigationCase:
    def __init__(self, probe, scale):
        self.probe, self.scale = probe, scale
        self.window = None
        self.minimum = None
        self.user = None
        self.targets = []
        self.phase = "created"

    def owned_frame(self):
        def read():
            tree = self.probe.tree()
            value = navigation_window(tree)
            return tree if value is not None and value[2] == self.window else None
        return self.probe.wait_for(read, "Detail navigation lost the original owned window")

    def target(self, resource, *, selected=None, touch=True, label=None):
        from profile_ui_probe import node_bounds
        previous, stable = None, 0
        def read():
            nonlocal previous, stable
            tree = self.owned_frame()
            node = navigation_target(tree, resource, minimum=self.minimum,
                                     selected=selected, touch=touch, label=label)
            signature = None if node is None else (node.get("bounds"), node.get("selected"), node.get("clickable"))
            stable = stable + 1 if signature is not None and signature == previous else int(signature is not None)
            previous = signature
            return node if stable >= 3 else None
        node = self.probe.wait_for(read, "Detail menu control did not settle: " + resource)
        self.targets.append({"resource": resource, "bounds": list(node_bounds(node)),
                             "window_id": self.window, "selected": node.get("selected") == "true"})
        return node

    def tap(self, resource, **kwargs):
        self.probe.tap_node(self.target(resource, **kwargs))

    def observed(self, page):
        from business_ui_probe import business_marker
        highest_requests = 0
        pending_frames = 0
        last_counts = None
        settled = False
        def read():
            nonlocal highest_requests, pending_frames, last_counts
            tree = self.owned_frame()
            value = detail_marker(tree)
            business = business_marker(tree, "strategy", "ready")
            if value is None or value["page"] != page or business is None:
                return None
            if self.user is not None and value["user"] != self.user:
                raise AssertionError("Detail navigation changed the isolated user")
            last_counts = (value["requests"], business["requests"])
            highest_requests = max(highest_requests, *last_counts)
            # Accessibility reads can straddle two asynchronous compositions.
            # Require agreement at the newest observed count within the SAME
            # existing wait deadline; stale agreement cannot complete the case.
            if last_counts[0] != last_counts[1] or last_counts[0] < highest_requests:
                pending_frames += 1
                return None
            return value
        try:
            value = self.probe.wait_for(read, "The real detail screen did not reach " + page)
            settled = True
            return value
        finally:
            if pending_frames:
                print("DETAIL_COUNTER_SETTLEMENT=" + json.dumps({
                    "page": page, "pending_frames": pending_frames,
                    "maximum_requests": highest_requests, "last_counts": last_counts,
                    "settled": settled,
                }, sort_keys=True), flush=True)

    def closed(self):
        return self.probe.wait_for(lambda: navigation_menu_absent(self.owned_frame()),
                                   "The detail navigation panel remained visible")

    def open_menu(self):
        self.tap("navigation-menu-open", label="Открыть меню")
        return self.target("navigation-menu-close", label="Закрыть меню")

    def menu_item(self, page, *, selected=None, touch=True):
        key, label = DETAILS[page]
        # The menu keeps its scroll state. Establish its real top first so a
        # previous visit to Library cannot make an earlier item unreachable.
        self.probe.reveal_resource("navigation-primary-home", "navigation-panel-content", direction="start",
                                   for_capture=True, minimum_size=(self.minimum, self.minimum))
        resource = "navigation-workspace-" + key
        self.probe.reveal_resource(resource, "navigation-panel-content", direction="end",
                                   for_capture=True, minimum_size=(self.minimum, self.minimum))
        return self.target(resource, selected=selected, touch=touch, label=label)

    def choose(self, page):
        self.open_menu()
        self.probe.tap_node(self.menu_item(page, selected=False))

    def capture(self, stem):
        from spatial_frame_evidence import read_screenshot
        path = self.probe.capture(stem + ("-font-200" if self.scale == 2.0 else ""))
        picture = read_screenshot(path)
        if not 0 < picture.width < picture.height:
            raise AssertionError("Detail navigation capture is not portrait")
        return {"screenshot": path.name, "screenshot_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "width": picture.width, "height": picture.height}

    def screen_anchor(self, page):
        if page == "strategy":
            self.reveal_horizon()
        elif page == "assistant":
            self.probe.wait_for(lambda: navigation_target(self.owned_frame(), "assistant-composer"),
                               "The real Assistant composer is absent")
        else:
            label = {"markets": "Ваши инструменты", "notifications": "Настроить события",
                     "appearance": "Единый стиль · движение и удобство",
                     "library": "Название, заметка или источник"}[page]
            self.probe.reveal(label, "workspace-content", direction="start", max_swipes=20)

    def reveal_horizon(self):
        from profile_scroll import fully_visible_resource
        minimum = (self.minimum, self.minimum)
        # The Goal editor places this input after the state, goal and risk
        # cards. Recover the fixture's actual top when returning from a saved
        # scroll position, but keep an already visible editor/IME in place.
        if fully_visible_resource(self.owned_frame(), "strategy-horizon",
                                  "workspace-content", minimum) is None:
            self.probe.reveal("Действует версия 3", "workspace-content",
                              direction="start", max_swipes=20)
        return self.probe.reveal_resource("strategy-horizon", "workspace-content", direction="end",
                                          for_capture=True, minimum_size=minimum)


    def horizon(self, value):
        from native_input_evidence import native_input_ready
        self.reveal_horizon()
        self.probe.tap_resource("strategy-horizon", "workspace-content", direction="end")
        result = self.probe.wait_for(lambda: native_input_ready(self.probe.tree(), value),
                                     "The real strategy editor did not retain " + value)
        return result

    def dirty_dialog(self):
        from profile_ui_probe import node_bounds
        def read():
            tree = self.probe.tree()
            window = navigation_window(tree)
            state = detail_marker(tree)
            if state is not None and state["page"] != "strategy":
                raise AssertionError("Panel navigation bypassed the dirty strategy confirmation")
            if window is None or window[2] == self.window:
                return None
            title = visible_label(tree, "Изменения стратегии")
            return {"window_id": window[2], "title_bounds": list(node_bounds(title))} if title is not None else None
        return self.probe.wait_for(read, "Dirty strategy did not open its real confirmation window")

    def dialog_action(self, dialog, label):
        from profile_ui_probe import node_bounds
        target = self.probe.label_tap_target(label, "workspace-content", direction="end", max_swipes=20)
        window = navigation_window(self.probe.tree())
        bounds = node_bounds(target)
        if window is None or window[2] != dialog["window_id"] or window[2] == self.window \
                or target.get("package") != PACKAGE or target.get("clickable") != "true" \
                or target.get("enabled") != "true" or target.get("visible-to-user") != "true" \
                or not (0 <= bounds[0] < bounds[2] <= window[0] and 0 <= bounds[1] < bounds[3] <= window[1]) \
                or bounds[2] - bounds[0] < self.minimum or bounds[3] - bounds[1] < self.minimum:
            raise AssertionError("The dirty confirmation action lost its owned 48dp target")
        self.probe.tap_node(target)
        return {"label": label, "bounds": list(bounds), "window_id": window[2]}

    def dirty_exit(self):
        from native_input_evidence import append_native_text, native_input_ready
        self.horizon("36")
        self.probe.command("shell", "input", "keyevent", "KEYCODE_MOVE_END")
        for _ in range(2):
            self.probe.command("shell", "input", "keyevent", "KEYCODE_DEL")
        self.probe.wait_for(lambda: native_input_ready(self.probe.tree(), ""), "Strategy draft was not cleared natively")
        append_native_text(self.probe, "", "48")
        # The same menu must remain reachable in the existing compact input
        # gutter. Observe the real IME before tapping, then preserve the draft.
        if self.probe.tree().get("keyboard-visible") != "true":
            raise AssertionError("The compact navigation check lost its native keyboard")
        self.open_menu()
        input_menu = self.capture("navigation-detail-menu-with-ime")
        self.tap("navigation-menu-close", label="Закрыть меню")
        self.closed()
        self.observed("strategy")
        self.horizon("48")
        self.probe.dismiss_keyboard()
        self.observed("strategy")
        self.choose("markets")
        cancelled = self.dirty_dialog()
        cancel_capture = self.capture("navigation-detail-dirty-cancel")
        cancel_action = self.dialog_action(cancelled, "Продолжить редактирование")
        self.closed()
        self.observed("strategy")
        self.horizon("48")
        self.probe.dismiss_keyboard()
        self.choose("markets")
        discarded = self.dirty_dialog()
        discard_action = self.dialog_action(discarded, "Отменить изменения")
        self.closed()
        self.observed("markets")
        self.screen_anchor("markets")
        self.choose("strategy")
        self.closed()
        self.observed("strategy")
        self.horizon("36")
        self.probe.dismiss_keyboard()
        return {"original_months": 36, "edited_months": 48, "cancelled_months": 48, "discarded_months": 36,
                "cancelled_dialog": cancelled, "cancel_action": cancel_action,
                "discarded_dialog": discarded, "discard_action": discard_action,
                "cancel_kept_strategy": True, "confirmed_discard_reached_markets": True,
                "menu_opened_with_native_ime": True, "input_menu": input_menu,
                "server_mutations": 0, **cancel_capture}

    def saved_appearance_anchor(self):
        # The saved caption is below the preview artwork/body, not at the
        # list's top. At large fonts it requires its own downward reveal.
        self.screen_anchor("appearance")
        return self.probe.reveal("Текущие сохранённые настройки", "workspace-content",
                                 direction="end", max_swipes=20)

    def appearance_exit(self):
        self.choose("appearance")
        self.closed()
        before = self.observed("appearance")
        density = before["preferences"].split(",")[1]
        target = "COMPACT" if density == "COMFORT" else "COMFORT"
        label = "Компактно" if target == "COMPACT" else "Свободно"
        self.probe.tap(label, "workspace-content", direction="end", max_swipes=20)
        preview = self.probe.wait_for(
            lambda: (value if value["preferences"].split(",")[1] == target else None)
            if (value := self.observed("appearance")) else None, "Appearance preview did not change natively")
        if preview["preferences"] == before["preferences"]:
            raise AssertionError("Appearance regression did not create a real uncommitted preview")
        self.choose("markets")
        self.closed()
        after = self.observed("markets")
        if after["preferences"] != before["preferences"]:
            raise AssertionError("Panel exit left the uncommitted appearance preview active")
        self.choose("appearance")
        self.closed()
        returned = self.observed("appearance")
        if returned["preferences"] != before["preferences"]:
            raise AssertionError("Returning to Appearance restored a cancelled preview")
        self.saved_appearance_anchor()
        result = {"before": before["preferences"], "preview": preview["preferences"],
                  "after": after["preferences"], "returned": returned["preferences"],
                  "cancelled_draft_did_not_reappear": True, **self.capture("navigation-detail-appearance-return")}
        self.choose("strategy")
        self.closed()
        self.observed("strategy")
        return result

    def start(self):
        from profile_launch import launch_profile
        from spatial_frame_evidence import ready_native_screen_metrics
        self.phase = "launch"
        self.probe.command("shell", "settings", "put", "system", "font_scale", str(self.scale))
        launch_profile(self.probe.command, self.probe.tree, self.probe.wait_for,
                       expected_screen="business-strategy", scenario="ready")
        renderer = self.probe.wait_for(lambda: ready_native_screen_metrics(
            self.probe.tree(), "business-strategy", self.scale),
                                       "Detail navigation lacks actual native rendering evidence")
        density = renderer.get("density", 0)
        if type(density) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(density) or not 0 < density <= 10 \
                or not math.isclose(renderer.get("font-scale", 0), self.scale, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-6) \
                or renderer.get("orientation") != "1":
            raise AssertionError("Detail navigation density/font/portrait evidence differs")
        self.minimum = math.ceil(48 * density - 1e-6)
        window = self.probe.wait_for(lambda: navigation_window(self.probe.tree()), "Missing owned detail window")
        self.window = window[2]
        initial = self.observed("strategy")
        self.user = initial["user"]
        pid = self.probe.command("shell", "pidof", PACKAGE).strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", pid) is None:
            raise AssertionError("Missing unique detail fixture process")
        return renderer, density, initial, pid

    def run(self):
        from profile_launch import profile_frame
        renderer, density, initial, pid = self.start()
        destinations = []
        current = "strategy"
        for page in DETAILS:
            self.phase = "destination-" + page
            if page != current:
                self.choose(page)
                self.closed()
            state = self.observed(page)
            self.screen_anchor(page)
            self.open_menu()
            selected = self.menu_item(page, selected=True, touch=False)
            from profile_ui_probe import node_bounds
            capture = self.capture("navigation-detail-" + page)
            self.tap("navigation-menu-close", label="Закрыть меню")
            self.closed()
            self.observed(page)
            destinations.append({"page": page, "observed": state, "selected_bounds": list(node_bounds(selected)), **capture})
            current = page
        self.choose("strategy")
        self.closed()
        self.observed("strategy")
        self.phase = "dirty-confirmation"
        dirty = self.dirty_exit()
        self.phase = "appearance-rollback"
        appearance = self.appearance_exit()
        self.phase = "final-source-observation"
        final = self.observed("strategy")
        if final["preferences"] != initial["preferences"]:

        final_pid = self.probe.command("shell", "pidof", PACKAGE).strip()
        if final_pid != pid:
            raise AssertionError("The app restarted during detail navigation")
        foreground = {}
        self.probe.wait_for(lambda: profile_frame(self.probe.command, self.probe.tree, foreground,
                           expected_screen="business-strategy", scenario="ready"), "Detail fixture lost foreground")
        return {"font_scale": self.scale, "renderer": renderer, "density": density,
                "minimum_touch_dp": 48, "main_window_id": self.window,
                "process_id": pid, "process_id_after": final_pid, "before": initial, "after": final,
                "destinations": destinations, "dirty_exit": dirty, "appearance_exit": appearance,
                "native_targets": self.targets, "foreground": foreground}


    def run_wide(self):
        from native_input_evidence import append_native_text, native_input_ready
        from profile_launch import foreground_observation, profile_resumed
        renderer, density, initial, pid = self.start()
        self.phase = "actual-wide-rail"
        rail = self.probe.wait_for(lambda: wide_rail_frame(self.owned_frame(), self.scale),
                                   "The production wide side rail is absent")
        if (rail["width"], rail["height"]) != (960, 1600) or not math.isclose(density, 1.0, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-6):
            raise AssertionError("Native wide geometry differs from the owned emulator profile")
        self.horizon("36")
        self.probe.command("shell", "input", "keyevent", "KEYCODE_MOVE_END")
        for _ in range(2):
            self.probe.command("shell", "input", "keyevent", "KEYCODE_DEL")
        self.probe.wait_for(lambda: native_input_ready(self.probe.tree(), ""), "Wide strategy draft did not clear")
        append_native_text(self.probe, "", "48")
        self.probe.dismiss_keyboard()
        self.observed("strategy")
        self.probe.wait_for(lambda: wide_rail_frame(self.owned_frame(), self.scale), "Wide rail did not remain visible")
        self.phase = "wide-dirty-cancel"
        self.tap("rail-destination-home", selected=False, label="Главная")
        cancelled = self.dirty_dialog()
        cancel_capture = self.capture("navigation-wide-dirty-cancel")
        cancel_action = self.dialog_action(cancelled, "Продолжить редактирование")
        self.closed()
        after_cancel = self.observed("strategy")
        self.horizon("48")
        self.probe.dismiss_keyboard()
        self.probe.wait_for(lambda: wide_rail_frame(self.owned_frame(), self.scale), "Cancellation lost the wide rail")
        self.phase = "wide-dirty-discard"
        self.tap("rail-destination-home", selected=False, label="Главная")
        discarded = self.dirty_dialog()
        discard_capture = self.capture("navigation-wide-dirty-discard")
        discard_action = self.dialog_action(discarded, "Отменить изменения")
        self.phase = "wide-confirmed-fixture-exit"
        def exited():
            tree = self.probe.tree()
            if tree is None or any(node.get("package") == PACKAGE and node.get("visible-to-user") != "false"
                                   for node in tree.iter("node")):
                return None
            activities = self.probe.command("shell", "dumpsys", "activity", "activities")
            foreground = foreground_observation(activities)
            if profile_resumed(activities) or not any("ResumedActivity" in line for line in foreground):
                return None
            if self.probe.command("shell", "pidof", PACKAGE).strip() != pid:
                raise AssertionError("A process death cannot prove the confirmed fixture exit")
            return {"profile_no_longer_resumed": True, "owned_app_window_gone": True,
                    "process_id_after": pid, "foreground": foreground}
        exit_observation = self.probe.wait_for(exited, "Confirmed wide navigation did not leave the actual fixture")
        # This fixture's primary callback is its real onBack/Activity.finish.
        # The original four navigation receipts separately cover primary screen
        # rendering; do not relabel this editor-exit observation as a Home render.
        return {"font_scale": self.scale, "renderer": renderer, "density": density,
                "minimum_touch_dp": 48, "actual_wide_rail": rail, "main_window_id": self.window,
                "process_id": pid, "before": initial, "after_cancel": after_cancel,
                "original_months": 36, "edited_months": 48, "cancelled_months": 48,
                "requested_primary": "home", "cancel_kept_strategy": True,
                "cancelled_dialog": cancelled, "cancel_action": cancel_action,
                "discarded_dialog": discarded, "discard_action": discard_action,
                "cancel_capture": cancel_capture, "discard_capture": discard_capture,
                "confirmed_fixture_exit": exit_observation, "primary_screen_render_claimed": False,
                "server_mutations": 0, "native_targets": self.targets}

"""One authenticated UiAutomation session per disposable-emulator run.

Fresh frame reads and narrowly scoped accessibility scroll actions only. No shell
fallback: disconnected or invalid frames fail. This is not part of the preview APK.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import contextmanager
from backend.android_runtime_contract import TARGET_SDK
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import re
import secrets
import socket
import struct
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

DRIVER_PACKAGE = "ru.omnicio.ciframe"
DRIVER_COMPONENT = DRIVER_PACKAGE + "/.FrameInstrumentation"
MAX_FRAME_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024
FRAME_TIMEOUT = 30
FRAME_DEADLINE_ERROR = "Fresh UI frame deadline exceeded"
SHOW_ON_SCREEN_FLAG = 0x20000000
ACTION_FLAG = 0x80000000
ACTION_START_FLAG = 0x10000000
ACTION_LIST_SHIFT = 24
REQUEST_SEQUENCE_MASK = 0x00FFFFFF
SCROLL_LIST_CODES = {
    "profile-content": 1,
    "education-content": 2,
    "portfolio-content": 3,
    "profile-tabs": 4,
    "workspace-content": 5,
    "dossier-tabs": 6,
    "quotes-intervals": 7,
    "assistant-composer": 8,
    "navigation-panel-content": 9,
    "navigation-row-main": 10,
    "navigation-row-portfolio": 11,
    "navigation-row-research": 12,
    "navigation-row-personal": 13,
}


def read_exact(connection, size: int, *, deadline: float) -> bytes:
    data = bytearray()
    while len(data) < size:
        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0:
            raise TimeoutError(FRAME_DEADLINE_ERROR)
        connection.settimeout(remaining)
        part = connection.recv(size - len(data))
        if not part:
            raise ConnectionError("UiAutomation session ended before a complete frame")
        data.extend(part)
    return bytes(data)


class FrameReader:
    def __init__(self, connection):
        self.connection = connection
        self.sequence = 0
        self.broken = False

    def _next_sequence(self) -> int:
        self.sequence += 1
        if not 0 < self.sequence <= REQUEST_SEQUENCE_MASK:
            raise ValueError("UiAutomation request sequence exhausted")
        return self.sequence

    def tree(self, *, deadline: float | None = None):
        if self.broken:
            raise ConnectionError("Failed UiAutomation stream cannot reuse a previous frame")
        try:
            sequence = self._next_sequence()
            if deadline is None:
                deadline = time.monotonic() + FRAME_TIMEOUT
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError(FRAME_DEADLINE_ERROR)
            self.connection.settimeout(remaining)
            self.connection.sendall(struct.pack(">I", sequence))
            received, status, size = struct.unpack(
                ">III", read_exact(self.connection, 12, deadline=deadline)
            )
            if received != sequence or status not in (0, 1) or size > MAX_FRAME_BYTES:
                raise ValueError("Invalid or stale UiAutomation frame envelope")
            payload = read_exact(self.connection, size, deadline=deadline)
            if status == 0:
                if size != 0:
                    raise ValueError("A null-root response must not contain stale XML")
                return None
            if not payload or b"<!DOCTYPE" in payload.upper() or b"<!ENTITY" in payload.upper():
                raise ValueError("Missing or unsafe accessibility XML")
            root = ET.fromstring(payload)
            if root.tag != "hierarchy" or next(root.iter("node"), None) is None:
                raise ValueError("UiAutomation returned an empty hierarchy")
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError(FRAME_DEADLINE_ERROR)
            return root
        except Exception:
            self.broken = True
            raise

    def scroll_list(self, resource_id: str, direction: str) -> bool:
        """Perform one exact public scroll action on one whitelisted app list.

        Coordinates, arbitrary resource names and arbitrary action identifiers do
        not cross this protocol. An acknowledgement is not UI evidence: callers
        must read and validate the next fresh frame before accepting any result.
        False means the exact list was valid but already at that semantic boundary;
        it does not invalidate the authenticated UiAutomation stream.
        """
        code = SCROLL_LIST_CODES.get(resource_id)
        if code is None:
            raise ValueError("Unknown semantic scroll list")
        if direction not in {"start", "end"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown semantic scroll direction")
        if self.broken:
            raise ConnectionError("Failed UiAutomation stream cannot perform actions")
        try:
            sequence = self._next_sequence()
            raw_request = ACTION_FLAG | (code << ACTION_LIST_SHIFT) | sequence
            if direction == "start":
                raw_request |= ACTION_START_FLAG
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
            self.connection.settimeout(12)
            self.connection.sendall(struct.pack(">I", raw_request))
            received, status, size = struct.unpack(
                ">III", read_exact(self.connection, 12, deadline=deadline)
            )
            if received != sequence or status not in (2, 3) or size != 0:
                raise ValueError("Invalid semantic scroll acknowledgement")
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("Semantic scroll acknowledgement exceeded deadline")
            performed = status == 2
            print(
                f"UI_ACCESSIBILITY_ACTION=list-{resource_id};scroll-{direction};"
                f"performed-{str(performed).lower()};sequence-{sequence}",
                flush=True,
            )
            return performed
        except Exception:
            self.broken = True
            raise


    def show_on_screen(self, resource_id: str, target_id: str) -> bool:
        """Request only public minimal scrolling of an observed descendant.

        The driver resolves the exact visible target again inside the exact
        whitelisted list. No click, arbitrary action or app state crosses this
        protocol. The acknowledgement never substitutes for a fresh UI frame.
        """
        code = SCROLL_LIST_CODES.get(resource_id)
        if code is None or not isinstance(target_id, str) or not 1 <= len(target_id) <= 96 or re.fullmatch(
                r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?::[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)*", target_id, flags=re.ASCII) is None:
            raise ValueError("Unknown list or invalid native reveal target")
        if self.broken:
            raise ConnectionError("Failed UiAutomation stream cannot perform actions")
        try:
            sequence = self._next_sequence()
            raw_request = SHOW_ON_SCREEN_FLAG | (code << ACTION_LIST_SHIFT) | sequence
            target = target_id.encode("ascii")
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
            self.connection.settimeout(12)
            self.connection.sendall(struct.pack(">IH", raw_request, len(target)) + target)
            received, status, size = struct.unpack(
                ">III", read_exact(self.connection, 12, deadline=deadline)
            )
            if received != sequence or status not in (5, 6) or size != 0:
                raise ValueError("Invalid native reveal acknowledgement")
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("Native reveal acknowledgement exceeded deadline")
            performed = status == 5
            print(f"UI_ACCESSIBILITY_ACTION=list-{resource_id};show-{target_id};"
                  f"performed-{str(performed).lower()};sequence-{sequence}", flush=True)
            return performed
        except Exception:
            self.broken = True
            raise

    def scroll_portfolio(self) -> bool:
        """Compatibility wrapper for the original exact portfolio action."""
        return self.scroll_list("portfolio-content", "end")

    def ready_tree(self):
        # A successfully received null root can occur while a dialog closes.
        # Wait only for that explicit not-ready response, within the original
        # frame budget. Every retry requests a NEW sequence; malformed frames,
        # transport errors and missing/wrong UI labels are never retried here.
        deadline = time.monotonic() + FRAME_TIMEOUT
        pending = 0
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            root = self.tree(deadline=deadline)
            if root is not None:
                if pending:
                    print(f"UIAUTOMATION_ROOT_READY=pending-{pending};sequence-{self.sequence}", flush=True)
                return root
            pending += 1
            if pending == 1:
                print(f"UIAUTOMATION_ROOT_PENDING=sequence-{self.sequence}", flush=True)
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining > 0:
                time.sleep(min(0.1, remaining))
        raise RuntimeError(f"UiAutomation active root is not ready within {FRAME_TIMEOUT}s ({pending} null frames)")


def checked(device, *args, timeout=30):
    response = device(*args, timeout=timeout)
    if response.returncode:
        detail = (response.stdout + "\n" + response.stderr).strip()[-1500:]
        raise RuntimeError(f"CI frame command failed ({response.returncode}): {detail}")
    return response.stdout


def assert_disposable(device):
    avd = checked(device, "emu", "avd", "name").splitlines()
    if not any(re.fullmatch(r"analyst-install-\d+-[12]", line.strip()) for line in avd):
        raise ValueError("Frame instrumentation is restricted to the owned disposable AVD")
    if checked(device, "shell", "getprop", "ro.kernel.qemu").strip() != "1":
        raise ValueError("Frame instrumentation refuses physical devices")
    if checked(device, "shell", "getprop", "ro.build.version.sdk").strip() != str(TARGET_SDK):
        raise ValueError("Frame instrumentation requires the current tested Android image")


def connect_session(port: int, token: str):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
    last_error = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        connection = None
        try:
            connection = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=2)
            connection.settimeout(30)
            connection.sendall(token.encode("ascii"))
            version = read_exact(connection, 4, deadline=deadline)
            if version != struct.pack(">I", 2):
                raise ValueError("Unexpected UiAutomation session protocol")
            return connection
        except OSError as error:
            last_error = error
            if connection is not None:
                connection.close()
            time.sleep(0.25)
        except Exception:
            if connection is not None:
                connection.close()
            raise
    raise TimeoutError("Persistent UiAutomation did not become ready") from last_error


def cleanup_session(device, connection, port, original):
    errors = []
    if connection is not None:
        try:
            connection.sendall(struct.pack(">I", 0))
        except OSError as error:
            errors.append(error)
        finally:
            try:
                connection.close()
            except OSError as error:
                errors.append(error)
    commands = [("shell", "am", "force-stop", DRIVER_PACKAGE)]
    if port is not None:
        commands.append(("forward", "--remove", f"tcp:{port}"))
    for args in commands:
        try:
            checked(device, *args, timeout=10)
        except Exception as error:
            errors.append(error)
    if errors:
        if original is None:
            raise errors[0]
        original.add_note("CI frame cleanup failed: " + ", ".join(type(e).__name__ for e in errors))


def start_instrumentation(device, session: str, token: str) -> str:
    """Keep am's watcher alive: without -w Android provides no UiAutomation.

    The only shell interpolation is freshly generated, validated hex. All
    descriptors are redirected so the launch call returns while am -w retains
    the instrumentation connection. Stopping the owned helper ends that watcher.
    """
    if re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{32}", session) is None or re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", token) is None:
        raise ValueError("Invalid instrumentation session identity")
    log = "/data/local/tmp/analyst-ci-frame-" + session + ".log"
    command = (
        "am instrument -w -r -e session " + session + " -e token " + token
        + " " + DRIVER_COMPONENT + " > " + log + " 2>&1 < /dev/null &"
    )
    checked(device, "shell", command)
    return log


def report_session_failure(device, log: str | None, token: str, original) -> None:
    if log is None:
        return
    try:
        detail = checked(device, "shell", "tail", "-c", "2000", log, timeout=10)
        print("UIAUTOMATION_SESSION_FAILURE=" + detail.replace(token, "[redacted]"), flush=True)
    except Exception as error:
        original.add_note("Frame-session diagnostics unavailable: " + type(error).__name__)


@contextmanager
def frame_session(device):
    assert_disposable(device)
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    apk = root / "ci-ui-driver/build/outputs/apk/debug/ci-ui-driver-debug.apk"
    if apk.is_symlink() or not apk.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not apk.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing or unsafe CI-only frame driver APK")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(apk.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    # -t is solely for this separate testOnly helper, never the preview candidate.
    installed = checked(device, "install", "--no-streaming", "-t", str(apk), timeout=120)
    if "Success" not in installed.splitlines():
        raise RuntimeError("CI-only frame driver installation was not confirmed")
    print("CI_FRAME_DRIVER_SHA256=" + digest, flush=True)
    connection = None
    port = None
    log = None
    token = ""
    try:
        session = secrets.token_hex(16)
        token = secrets.token_hex(32)
        log = start_instrumentation(device, session, token)
        value = checked(device, "forward", "tcp:0", "localabstract:analyst-ci-frame-" + session).strip()
        if not value.isdecimal() or not 1024 <= int(value) <= 65535:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected loopback forwarding port")
        port = int(value)
        connection = connect_session(port, token)
        print("UIAUTOMATION_SESSION=connected;protocol=2", flush=True)
        yield FrameReader(connection).ready_tree
    except Exception as original:
        report_session_failure(device, log, token, original)
        raise
    finally:
        cleanup_session(device, connection, port, sys.exc_info()[1])

"""Saved appearance, temporary preview and real Activity recreation."""
from business_ui_probe import labels
from profile_launch import PACKAGE
from profile_ui_probe import button_label
from spatial_frame_evidence import ready_spatial_metrics

MOTION_DISABLED = 'Без движения'
BRIGHT_LIGHTING = 'Яркое освещение'


AREA = "workspace-content"
DIRTY = "Предпросмотр · настройки ещё не сохранены"
DEFAULT = {"motion": "LIVE", "bright_light": False, "accent": "AURORA", "depth": True, "density": "COMFORT"}
APPLIED = {"motion": "OFF", "bright_light": True, "accent": "AURORA", "depth": True, "density": "COMFORT"}
PREVIEW = {**APPLIED, "motion": "SUBDUED", "bright_light": False}


def selected_control(tree, text, *, checked=None):
    """Read an actual native selected/radio/switch ancestor of its label."""
    for node in tree.iter("node"):
        if node.get("package") != PACKAGE or node.get("visible-to-user") != "true":
            continue
        selected = node.get("selected") == "true" or node.get("checked") == "true"
        if checked is None and not selected:
            continue
        if checked is not None and (node.get("checkable") != "true" or node.get("checked") != str(checked).lower()):
            continue
        if any(text in labels(child) for child in node.iter("node")
               if child.get("package") == PACKAGE and child.get("visible-to-user") == "true"):
            return node
    return None


def _expect_preferences(case, expected):
    return case.expect(lambda value: value["prefs"] == expected, "Observed appearance differs from the actual chosen controls")


def _reset(case):
    p = case.probe
    sections = ("Движение", "Яркое освещение", "Приватность")
    p.reveal("Единый стиль · движение и удобство", AREA, direction="start")
    for heading in sections:
        p.reveal(heading, AREA)
    p.tap("Вернуть оформление по умолчанию", AREA)
    for heading in reversed(sections):
        p.reveal(heading, AREA, direction="start")
    p.reveal("Единый стиль · движение и удобство", AREA, direction="start")
    p.reveal("Применить", AREA)
    apply = button_label(p.tree(), "Применить")
    if apply is None or apply.get("enabled") not in {"true", "false"}:
        raise AssertionError("Appearance reset has no native Apply button state")
    if apply.get("enabled") == "true":
        # The text child can be clipped or enabled under a disabled owner.
        # Apply through the same settled 48px action used by the user flow.
        p.tap("Применить", AREA)
        p.reveal("Оформление применено", AREA, direction="start")
    _expect_preferences(case, DEFAULT)


def _preview(case):
    p = case.probe
    p.reveal("Единый стиль · движение и удобство", AREA, direction="start")
    p.tap("Сдержанное", AREA)
    p.tap(BRIGHT_LIGHTING, AREA)
    _expect_preferences(case, PREVIEW)
    p.reveal(DIRTY, AREA, direction="start")


def _rotate_preview(case):
    from emulator_rotation import portrait_turn, portrait_geometry
    p = case.probe
    original_geometry = portrait_geometry(p.tree())
    with portrait_turn(p.command):
        _expect_preferences(case, PREVIEW)
        p.reveal(DIRTY, AREA, direction="start")
        case.capture("preview-rotation")
        after = portrait_geometry(p.tree())
        if after != original_geometry:
            raise AssertionError("Appearance preview changed its portrait geometry")
        case.extra["appearance_rotation"] = {"before_geometry": original_geometry,
            "after_geometry": after, "orientation_policy": "portrait", "unsaved_preview": PREVIEW}
    _expect_preferences(case, PREVIEW)


def exercise_appearance(case):
    p = case.probe
    p.find("Оформление")
    _reset(case)
    p.tap(MOTION_DISABLED, AREA)
    p.tap(BRIGHT_LIGHTING, AREA)
    p.reveal(DIRTY, AREA, direction="start")
    p.tap("Применить", AREA)
    _expect_preferences(case, APPLIED)
    p.reveal("Оформление применено", AREA, direction="start")
    case.capture("applied")
    restored = case.launch()  # Same run/user, real process stop and relaunch.
    if restored["prefs"] != APPLIED:
        raise AssertionError("Applied appearance was not persisted across the real process restart")
    p.reveal(MOTION_DISABLED, AREA)
    p.wait_for(lambda: selected_control(p.tree(), MOTION_DISABLED), "Saved motion has no actual native selected state")
    p.reveal(BRIGHT_LIGHTING, AREA)
    p.wait_for(lambda: selected_control(p.tree(), BRIGHT_LIGHTING, checked=True), "Saved bright-light mode has no actual checked switch")
    def motion_off():
        actual = ready_spatial_metrics(p.tree())
        return actual if actual is not None and actual["motion"] == "Off" else None
    p.wait_for(motion_off, "Saved motion preference did not reach the genuine renderer")
    case.extra["saved_preferences_after_restart"] = restored["prefs"]
    case.capture("restored")
    _preview(case)
    p.tap("Отменить", AREA)
    _expect_preferences(case, APPLIED)
    _preview(case)
    _rotate_preview(case)
    p.tap("Отменить", AREA, direction="end")
    _expect_preferences(case, APPLIED)
    _reset(case)
    return ["appearance-explicit-apply", "same-user-process-restart-persistence",
            "native-radio-and-bright-switch-state", "saved-off-reaches-renderer",
            "preview-cancel-restores-saved", "unsaved-preview-survives-rotation"]

"""Bounded gestures in an explicitly chosen Analyst list; never another app."""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
import re
import time
import json
import math
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

PACKAGE = "ru.omnicio.app.debug"
SCROLL_AXES = {
    "profile-content": "vertical",
    "education-content": "vertical",
    "portfolio-content": "vertical",
    "workspace-content": "vertical",
    "assistant-composer": "vertical",
    "navigation-panel-content": "vertical",
    "navigation-row-main": "horizontal",
    "navigation-row-portfolio": "horizontal",
    "navigation-row-research": "horizontal",
    "navigation-row-personal": "horizontal",
    "profile-tabs": "horizontal",
    "dossier-tabs": "horizontal",
    "quotes-intervals": "horizontal",
}
LIST_IDS = frozenset(SCROLL_AXES)


def _bounds(node: ET.Element) -> tuple[int, int, int, int] | None:
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\[(\d{1,6}),(\d{1,6})\]\[(\d{1,6}),(\d{1,6})\]", node.get("bounds", ""))
    if match is None:
        return None
    left, top, right, bottom = map(int, match.groups())
    return (left, top, right, bottom) if right > left and bottom > top else None


def _visible_app_node(node: ET.Element) -> bool:
    return (
        node.get("package") == PACKAGE
        and node.get("visible-to-user") != "false"
        and _bounds(node) is not None
    )


def visible_label(tree: ET.Element, text: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    for node in tree.iter("node"):
        if not _visible_app_node(node):
            continue
        labels = node.get("text", "").splitlines() + node.get("content-desc", "").splitlines()
        if text in [label.strip() for label in labels]:
            return node
    return None


def visible_resource(tree: ET.Element, resource_id: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Find an exact Compose testTag exposed to UiAutomator as a resource id.

    Compose commonly exposes the tag itself (for example ``lesson-toggle-x``),
    while older dumps can contain the package-qualified Android spelling. Both
    exact forms are accepted; substrings and nodes from another package are not.
    """
    names = {resource_id, f"{PACKAGE}:id/{resource_id}"}
    for node in tree.iter("node"):
        if _visible_app_node(node) and node.get("resource-id") in names:
            return node
    return None


def tappable_resource(tree: ET.Element, target_id: str, list_id: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Clip a target to its list viewport before using its tap coordinates.

    Compose can report a child's logical bounds while most of the button is
    still below the clipped list. Canvas pointer-input targets need not expose
    clickable=true, so the caller must assert the resulting interaction state.
    """
    target = visible_resource(tree, target_id)
    viewport = _list_area(tree, list_id, require_scrollable=False)
    if target is None or viewport is None:
        return None
    if target.get("enabled") == "false":
        return None
    left, top, right, bottom = _bounds(target)
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = viewport
    left, top = max(left, x1), max(top, y1)
    right, bottom = min(right, x2), min(bottom, y2)
    if right - left < 48 or bottom - top < 48:
        return None
    clipped = ET.Element(target.tag, dict(target.attrib))
    clipped.set("bounds", f"[{left},{top}][{right},{bottom}]")
    return clipped


def fully_visible_resource(tree: ET.Element, target_id: str, list_id: str,
                           minimum_size: tuple[float, float] = (0, 0)) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Require the whole evidence target inside its current list viewport.

    A Compose node can retain logical bounds and visible-to-user=true after
    scrolling behind a sticky header. Such bounds cannot identify captured pixels.
    """
    target = visible_resource(tree, target_id)
    # Content may fit entirely in a wide viewport. Visibility does not
    # require a scroll range; gesture authorization still does.
    viewport = _list_area(tree, list_id, require_scrollable=False)
    if target is None or viewport is None:
        return None
    left, top, right, bottom = _bounds(target)
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = viewport
    # UiAutomator may return an ALREADY clipped rectangle. Containment alone
    # cannot prove the whole target is visible; use the fixture's declared size.
    if right - left < minimum_size[0] or bottom - top < minimum_size[1]:
        return None
    return target if x1 <= left < right <= x2 and y1 <= top < bottom <= y2 else None


def settled_resource(read_tree, target_id: str, list_id: str, max_frames: int = 20):
    """Require three equal fresh rectangles after an asynchronous scroll."""
    if list_id not in LIST_IDS or not 3 <= max_frames <= 30:
        raise ValueError("Unknown list or invalid frame limit")
    previous, stable = None, 0
    for _ in range(max_frames):
        target = tappable_resource(read_tree(), target_id, list_id)
        bounds = target.get("bounds") if target is not None else None
        stable = stable + 1 if bounds is not None and bounds == previous else int(bounds is not None)
        if stable >= 3:
            return target
        previous = bounds
        time.sleep(0.1)
    raise AssertionError("List button geometry did not settle: " + target_id)


def _scroll_area(tree: ET.Element, resource_id: str):
    return _list_area(tree, resource_id, require_scrollable=True)


def _list_area(tree: ET.Element, resource_id: str, *, require_scrollable: bool):
    names = {resource_id, f"{PACKAGE}:id/{resource_id}"}
    candidates = [
        node
        for node in tree.iter("node")
        if node.get("package") == PACKAGE
        and node.get("resource-id") in names
        and (not require_scrollable or node.get("scrollable") == "true")
        and node.get("visible-to-user") != "false"
    ]
    # Ambiguous simultaneous lists must not pick an arbitrary scroll target.
    return _bounds(candidates[0]) if len(candidates) == 1 else None


def _gesture(bounds, axis: str, direction: str):
    left, top, right, bottom = bounds
    if axis == "horizontal":
        if right - left < 8 or bottom - top < 2:
            return None
        inset = max(1, (right - left) // 5)
        middle = (top + bottom) // 2
        start, end = (right - inset, middle), (left + inset, middle)
    else:
        if bottom - top < 8 or right - left < 2:
            return None
        inset = max(1, (bottom - top) // 5)
        middle = (left + right) // 2
        start, end = (middle, bottom - inset), (middle, top + inset)
    return (*start, *end) if direction == "end" else (*end, *start)


def _reveal_target(
    read_tree: Callable,
    swipe: Callable,
    find_target: Callable[[ET.Element], ET.Element | None],
    target_description: str,
    *,
    resource_id: str,
    max_swipes: int,
    direction: str,
    layout_timeout: float,
    reveal_partial: Callable[[ET.Element], bool] | None = None,
) -> ET.Element | None:
    _validate_request(resource_id, direction, max_swipes, layout_timeout)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + layout_timeout
    for attempt in range(max_swipes + 1):
        tree, target, bounds = _ready_scroll_frame(
            read_tree, find_target, resource_id, attempt, deadline, layout_timeout > 0
        )
        if target is not None:
            return target
        if bounds is None:
            return None
        gesture = _gesture(bounds, SCROLL_AXES[resource_id], direction)
        if gesture is None:
            return None
        expired = layout_timeout > 0 and time.monotonic() >= deadline
        if attempt == max_swipes or expired:
            _layout_diagnostic(tree, resource_id, attempt)
            raise AssertionError("List target not reachable: " + target_description)
        # A full-page action can split a small button across both page edges.
        # Align that observed target before another page can skip past it.
        if reveal_partial is None or not reveal_partial(tree):
            swipe(*gesture)
        if layout_timeout > 0:
            time.sleep(min(0.2, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
    raise AssertionError("List scroll did not finish")


def _validate_request(resource_id, direction, max_swipes, layout_timeout):
    if resource_id not in LIST_IDS:
        raise ValueError("unknown_scroll_list")
    if direction not in {"start", "end"}:
        raise ValueError("unknown_scroll_direction")
    if type(max_swipes) is not int or not 0 <= max_swipes <= 20:
        raise ValueError("invalid_scroll_limit")
    if type(layout_timeout) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(layout_timeout) or not 0 <= layout_timeout <= 12:
        raise ValueError("invalid_layout_timeout")


def _ready_scroll_frame(read_tree, find_target, resource_id, swipes, deadline, wait):
    pending = 0
    while True:
        tree = read_tree()
        target = find_target(tree)
        bounds = _scroll_area(tree, resource_id)
        if target is not None or bounds is not None or not wait:
            return tree, target, bounds
        # A valid active root can precede its Compose scroll semantics. Do not
        # switch to a passive label-only wait: an offscreen target still needs
        # scrolling when this exact list becomes available again.
        expired = time.monotonic() >= deadline
        if pending == 0 or expired:
            _layout_diagnostic(tree, resource_id, swipes)
        if expired:
            raise AssertionError("Scroll layout not ready: " + resource_id)
        pending += 1
        time.sleep(min(0.2, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))


def _layout_diagnostic(tree: ET.Element, resource_id: str, swipes: int) -> None:
    # Test tags and geometry only: no ordinary labels, balances or tokens.
    nodes = [
        {key: node.get(key, "") for key in (
            "package", "resource-id", "bounds", "scrollable", "visible-to-user"
        )}
        for node in tree.iter("node")
        if node.get("resource-id") in LIST_IDS
        or node.get("resource-id") in {f"{PACKAGE}:id/{name}" for name in LIST_IDS}
    ][:20]
    print("SCROLL_LAYOUT_DIAGNOSTIC=" + json.dumps({
        "area": resource_id, "swipes": swipes, "lists": nodes,
    }), flush=True)


def reveal_in_list(
    read_tree: Callable,
    swipe: Callable,
    text: str,
    *,
    resource_id: str,
    max_swipes: int = 10,
    direction: str = "end",
    layout_timeout: float = 0,
    for_tap: bool = False,
) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Return the visible exact label or fail after a bounded number of gestures.

    None means this particular list is not visible; no other list or system
    window is scrolled. A positive layout_timeout waits for this exact list
    within one overall deadline without resetting the swipe budget.
    Header/dialog labels may be found without any gesture. A tap requires the
    native action's visible geometry, not an offscreen logical text child.
    """
    find_target = lambda tree: visible_label(tree, text)
    if for_tap:
        from native_label_target import label_target

        find_target = lambda tree: label_target(tree, text, require_enabled=False)

    return _reveal_target(
        read_tree,
        swipe,
        find_target,
        text,
        resource_id=resource_id,
        max_swipes=max_swipes,
        direction=direction,
        layout_timeout=layout_timeout,
    )


def reveal_resource_in_list(
    read_tree: Callable,
    swipe: Callable,
    target_resource_id: str,
    *,
    resource_id: str,
    max_swipes: int = 10,
    direction: str = "end",
    layout_timeout: float = 0,
    for_tap: bool = False,
    for_capture: bool = False,
    minimum_size: tuple[float, float] = (0, 0),
    show_on_screen: Callable[[str, str], bool] | None = None,
) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Reveal an exact Compose testTag without depending on merged label text."""
    def find(tree):
        if for_capture:
            return fully_visible_resource(tree, target_resource_id, resource_id, minimum_size)
        if for_tap:
            return tappable_resource(tree, target_resource_id, resource_id)
        return visible_resource(tree, target_resource_id)
    def align_partial(tree):
        target = visible_resource(tree, target_resource_id)
        viewport = _scroll_area(tree, resource_id)
        if target is None or viewport is None or target.get("enabled") == "false":
            return False
        left, top, right, bottom = _bounds(target)
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = viewport
        if min(right, x2) <= max(left, x1) or min(bottom, y2) <= max(top, y1):
            return False
        if not show_on_screen(resource_id, target_resource_id):
            raise AssertionError("Native target could not be brought into view: " + target_resource_id)
        return True

    return _reveal_target(
        read_tree,
        swipe,
        find,
        target_resource_id,
        resource_id=resource_id,
        max_swipes=max_swipes,
        direction=direction,
        layout_timeout=layout_timeout,
        reveal_partial=align_partial if for_tap and show_on_screen is not None else None,
    )


def reveal_in_profile(
    read_tree: Callable,
    swipe: Callable,
    text: str,
    *,
    max_swipes: int = 10,
) -> ET.Element | None:
    return reveal_in_list(
        read_tree,
        swipe,
        text,
        resource_id="profile-content",
        max_swipes=max_swipes,
    )

"""UI checks use only the disposable emulator callback, never attached user phones."""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

APPLY_LABEL = 'Применить'
LIGHT_THEME_LABEL = 'Светлая'


PACKAGE = "ru.omnicio.app.debug"
ACTIVITY = PACKAGE + "/ru.omnicio.app.ProfileUiProbeActivity"
THEME_LABEL = "Оформление"
WORKSPACE_BACK = "Назад"
CONFIRM_LABEL = "Понятно"
SETTINGS_LABEL = "Настройки"
INFO_LABEL = "О приложении"
EDUCATION_LABEL = "Обучение"
BACK_FROM_EDUCATION = "Назад"
FIRST_LESSON = "Сначала цель, срок и резерв"
FIRST_LESSON_TOGGLE = "lesson-toggle-start-plan"
LIGHT_BACKGROUND = "ff050e1c"
DARK_BACKGROUND = "ff050e1c"


def matching_node(tree: ET.Element, text: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Compose may merge card labels into text or content-description nodes."""
    for node in tree.iter("node"):
        labels = node.get("text", "").splitlines() + node.get(
            "content-desc", ""
        ).splitlines()
        if text in [label.strip() for label in labels]:
            return node
    return None


def checkable_label(tree: ET.Element, text: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Resolve the native control, including labels in its unmerged children."""
    return _native_label(tree, text, "checkable", "true")


def button_label(tree: ET.Element, text: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    """Read the action owner's state, including Compose's separate role child.

    Compose exposes a non-leaf clickable as View, with a direct, unlabelled
    Button child for Role.Button. That child has no click action or Disabled
    property; enabled must be read from its clickable parent, not the role or
    text child. A label or arbitrary clickable without a button role is not
    evidence of a button.
    """
    matches = [node for node in tree.iter("node")
               if node.get("package") == PACKAGE
               and node.get("visible-to-user") != "false"
               and _owns_button_role(node)
               and matching_node(node, text) is not None]
    if len(matches) > 1:
        raise AssertionError("Ambiguous native control label: " + text)
    return matches[0] if matches else None


def _owns_button_role(node: ET.Element) -> bool:
    if node.get("class") == "android.widget.Button":
        return True
    if node.get("class") != "android.view.View" or node.get("clickable") != "true":
        return False
    return any(child.get("class") == "android.widget.Button"
               and child.get("package") == PACKAGE
               and child.get("visible-to-user") != "false"
               and child.get("clickable") == "false"
               and not child.get("text") and not child.get("content-desc")
               and len(child) == 0
               for child in node)


def _native_label(tree: ET.Element, text: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> ET.Element | None:
    matches = [node for node in tree.iter("node")
               if node.get("package") == PACKAGE
               and node.get("visible-to-user") != "false"
               and node.get(attribute) == value
               and matching_node(node, text) is not None]
    if len(matches) > 1:
        raise AssertionError("Ambiguous native control label: " + text)
    return matches[0] if matches else None


def node_bounds(node: ET.Element) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    match = re.fullmatch(
        r"\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]",
        node.get("bounds", ""),
    )
    if match is None:
        raise AssertionError("Missing UI bounds")
    left, top, right, bottom = map(int, match.groups())
    if left < 0 or top < 0 or right <= left or bottom <= top:
        raise AssertionError("UI target is empty or outside the visible screen")
    return left, top, right, bottom


def _horizontal_scroll_direction(x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int) -> str:
    if y1 != y2 or x1 == x2:
        raise ValueError("Horizontal semantic scroll geometry is invalid")
    return "end" if x2 < x1 else "start"


def _vertical_scroll_direction(x1: int, y1: int, x2: int, y2: int) -> str:
    if x1 != x2 or y1 == y2:
        raise ValueError("Vertical semantic scroll geometry is invalid")
    return "end" if y2 < y1 else "start"


def semantic_scroll_direction(
    area: str,
    x1: int,
    y1: int,
    x2: int,
    y2: int,
) -> str:
    if area in {"profile-tabs", "dossier-tabs", "quotes-intervals",
                "navigation-row-main", "navigation-row-portfolio",
                "navigation-row-research", "navigation-row-personal"}:
        return _horizontal_scroll_direction(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    return _vertical_scroll_direction(x1, y1, x2, y2)


class ProfileProbe:
    def __init__(self, device):
        self.device = device
        self.read_tree = None

    def command(self, *args, timeout=15):
        response = self.device(*args, timeout=timeout)
        if response.returncode:
            detail = (response.stdout + "\n" + response.stderr).strip()[-1500:]
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"UI test command failed ({response.returncode}): {detail}"
            )
        return response.stdout

    def tree(self):
        if self.read_tree is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Persistent UI frame session is not connected")
        return self.read_tree()

    def capture(self, name: str):
        """Capture a real frame through the official emulator console.

        Guest screencap stalls on this headless Windows lab with Compose dialogs
        (documented in PR #827 and reproduced by job 116433346814). Preserve the
        established console transport; it still must produce a complete PNG.
        A fresh directory prevents reusing a previous frame. Errors remain fatal.
        """
        if re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}", name) is None:
            raise ValueError("Invalid screenshot label")
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
        directory = root / "app/build/outputs/apk/preview/ui-screens"
        if directory.is_symlink() or not directory.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
            raise ValueError("Screenshot directory escapes checkout")
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination = directory / (name + ".png")
        if destination.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Screenshot destination is a symlink")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="capture-", dir=directory) as stage:
            self.command("emu", "screenrecord", "screenshot", stage)
            pictures = list(Path(stage).glob("*.png"))
            if len(pictures) != 1:
                raise AssertionError("Expected exactly one fresh emulator screenshot")
            picture = pictures[0]
            if not picture.is_file() or picture.is_symlink():
                raise AssertionError("Emulator screenshot is not a regular file")
            if not 100 <= picture.stat().st_size <= 2097152:
                raise AssertionError("Unexpected emulator screenshot size")
            image = picture.read_bytes()
            if not image.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") or not image.endswith(
                b"\x00\x00\x00\x00IEND\xaeB`\x82"
            ):
                raise AssertionError("Invalid or incomplete emulator screenshot")
            picture.replace(destination)
        print("PROFILE_SCREENSHOT=" + name, flush=True)
        return destination

    def wait_for(self, read, message):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
        last_error = None
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                value = read()
                if value is not None and value is not False:
                    return value
            except (RuntimeError, ET.ParseError, ValueError) as error:
                last_error = error
            time.sleep(0.2)
        raise AssertionError(message) from last_error

    def find(self, text):
        return self.wait_for(
            lambda: matching_node(self.tree(), text),
            "UI label not found: " + text,
        )

    def find_all(self, labels):
        """Check simultaneous labels in one fresh frame, not five new sessions."""

        def read():
            frame = self.tree()
            nodes = [matching_node(frame, label) for label in labels]
            return nodes if all(node is not None for node in nodes) else None

        return self.wait_for(
            read,
            "UI labels not found together: " + ", ".join(labels),
        )

    def bounds(self, text):
        return node_bounds(self.find(text))

    def _semantic_scroll_callback(self, area: str, direction: str):
        """Map validated list geometry to one exact accessibility action.

        The old shell drag could begin over a clickable profile card and open a
        modal dialog instead of scrolling. This callback keeps the existing
        bounded geometry contract, but delegates movement to the exact tagged
        Compose list through the owned persistent UiAutomation session.
        """
        from persistent_ui import FrameReader, SCROLL_LIST_CODES

        reader = getattr(self.read_tree, "__self__", None)
        if not isinstance(reader, FrameReader):
            raise ValueError("Semantic scrolling needs the owned frame session")
        if area not in SCROLL_LIST_CODES or direction not in {"start", "end"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown semantic scroll target")

        def scroll(x1, y1, x2, y2):
            observed = semantic_scroll_direction(area, x1, y1, x2, y2)
            if observed != direction:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Semantic scroll direction disagrees with list geometry"
                )
            reader.scroll_list(area, direction)

        return scroll

    def reveal(self, text, area="profile-content", direction="end", *, max_swipes=10):
        from profile_scroll import reveal_in_list

        target = reveal_in_list(
            self.tree,
            self._semantic_scroll_callback(area, direction),
            text,
            resource_id=area,
            direction=direction,
            max_swipes=max_swipes,
            layout_timeout=12,
        )
        if target is None:
            from profile_scroll import visible_label

            target = self.wait_for(
                lambda: visible_label(self.tree(), text),
                "UI label not visible: " + text,
            )
        return target

    def reveal_resource(
        self,
        resource_id,
        area="profile-content",
        direction="end",
        for_capture=False,
        minimum_size=(0, 0),
    ):
        from profile_scroll import reveal_resource_in_list

        target = reveal_resource_in_list(
            self.tree,
            self._semantic_scroll_callback(area, direction),
            resource_id,
            resource_id=area,
            direction=direction,
            layout_timeout=12,
            for_capture=for_capture,
            minimum_size=minimum_size,
        )
        if target is None:
            from profile_scroll import visible_resource, fully_visible_resource

            target = self.wait_for(
                lambda: fully_visible_resource(self.tree(), resource_id, area, minimum_size)
                if for_capture else visible_resource(self.tree(), resource_id),
                "UI resource not visible: " + resource_id,
            )
        return target
